description: The public heistclips board of feature requests and bug reports: every item with its kind (feature or bug), upvotes, status (requested, building, shipped), and for closed items the builder's response and shipped_at date, most upvoted first. Titles and details are in English; a request written in another language also carries its original text and language code under original. A request already on the board can be upvoted instead of filed twice.

kind.description: Only feature requests, or only bug reports

name: list_feature_requests
title: heistclips feature requests
